video_title: How close was LeBron to signing with the Cavaliers this offseason? 👀 + 76ers’ outlook | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James considered returning to the Cavaliers in free agency
quotes.excerpt: Back in July when he was mulling over his free agency decision, the Cavs were one of the five teams
quotes.quote: Back in July when he was mulling over his free agency decision, the Cavs were one of the five teams that it came down to. Ultimately, he chose the Sixers. In these last eight years when he played with the Lakers, he went three and three in his return games here to Cleveland, and it was mostly vociferous cheers for LeBron, a great deal of appreciation and admiration for what he did for the franchise in his second stint, making it to four straight NBA Finals and winning the championship in 2016.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James brings essential leadership to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Cleveland is missing something that LeBron is bringing, one of the things that he is bringing, leadership.
quotes.quote: Cleveland is missing something that LeBron is bringing, one of the things that he is bringing, leadership. We can look at Cleveland right now and ask, it is almost like it is Christmas Day as a kid. You go there, you see this big pretty box, it is a bow on top, and you are like, man, I know it is good up in there. I know my parents, grandparents took good care of me. And all of a sudden you open it, and it is some long johns and some Kleenex. I am expecting a PlayStation. That is the Cleveland Cavaliers, right? They got all the pieces, but for some reason they cannot put it together because there is not a leader in there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey has grown significantly in confidence and leadership
quotes.excerpt: When Maxey came back, he had grown a foot in confidence. This guy is already an All-Star.
quotes.quote: One of the things that Nick Nurse has said repeatedly is that when Maxey came back, he had grown a foot in confidence. This guy is already an All-Star. It was not like we did not know this guy could play. This guy has been confident. We come in, Jaylen Brown and LeBron are coming, you think you might take a step back. No, no, no. Maxey took a step forward in his confidence level and leadership.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley needs to be unlocked as a primary option
quotes.excerpt: When are we going to see him take that Anthony Davis type leap?
quotes.quote: Stop holding back Evan Mobley. Evan Mobley is still one of the most skilled bigs in this league, and for the last two years, I have been on this stage asking, when are we going to lock a different version of him? When are we going to see him take that Anthony Davis type leap where we could know and look at a box score without watching a game and say, Evan Mobley is going to give me 25 and 12. But if Donovan Mitchell and James Harden does not put that key in his back and let him know that, hey man, you are that guy we are going to go through you, then he is never going to be the best version of him.
